description: File a support ticket for CallPilotAI itself — the same channel as the feedback button at the bottom right of the website, so it lands in the same queue and gets answered the same way. Use it when you hit something that looks like a defect in the product rather than a problem with the data: a tool that errors where it should not, a wrong result, a missing capability that blocks the task. Required: description — write what you tried, what happened and what you expected, in that order; a ticket without the expectation costs a round trip before it can be read. Optional: severity (low|normal|high|critical — a hint in the text, the support side does the actual triage), contact_email (who should be answered; omit and the answer stays inside support-ai-ze), error_text (paste the error VERBATIM, do not summarise it), page_url, tool_name (which tool misbehaved). Tenant, user, agent and — if you are switched into another tenant — that fact are attached automatically. This writes into OUR support system, not into the customer's data.

contact_email.description: Who should be answered; omit to keep the answer inside support

description.description: What you tried, what happened and what you expected

severity.description: Severity hint: low, normal, high or critical

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that misbehaved

name: report_issue
